title_en: Score Palworld, V Rising, Subnautica: Below Zero, and More with This Survival of the Fittest Humble Bundle
body_en:
Black Friday is one of the best times of the year to buy video games , and our friends at Humble Bundle have a great bundle available right now where you can score 12 Steam keys for $25. If you're a fan of survival games like Palworld, V Rising, and Subnautica: Below Zero, you do not want to miss out on the Survival of the Fittest Bundle. Check out the details below, and start your Black Friday wins early with these huge savings.
To get all 12 items in the bundle, you'll need to pay $25. You can also pay $15 for 10 items or a custom amount for a select number of games. If you grab the entire bundle, you'll get access to the following items:
One of the highlights of this package is Palworld , which launched out of early access this year. The co-op survival game blends creature collecting in brilliant fashion, and it's an absolute treat for fans of any genre. There's also Subnautica: Below Zero , the excellent 2021 smaller follow-up to Subnautica, and V Rising, which we gave a 9/10 to in our review .
The Survival of the Fittest bundle supports the Whale and Dolphin Conservation . Also known as WDC, this organization is dedicated to protecting whales and dolphins around the world. The WDC offers educational programs, scientific research, and conversation efforts to help ensure these animals thrive in the wild. This mission includes ending commercial whaling, protecting the habitats of whales and dolphins, as well as ending captivity.
Noah Hunter is a freelance writer and reviewer covering games and technology. When he's not writing for IGN, he runs Final Weapon, a site focused on Japanese games and anime. His favorite series include Xeno, Fate, Final Fantasy, and far too many RPGs to list.
